messages.text: Morning all. Draw request #3 just came in on the construction loan for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0181}}, $412K against the framing and MEP milestones. Who's got capacity to review today? Funding window is Thursday.
That's my relationship so I can take it, but I'd rather someone else underwrite the draw review for a second set of eyes. Joshua, you free?
Yep, I can pick it up after my 10:30. Brendan, did the inspector's report come with the package or is that still outstanding?
Report is attached, third-party inspector signed off on 68% complete. Lien waivers from the GC and the electrical sub are in. Plumbing sub waiver still missing.
68% complete vs. what the schedule of values says? If we're advancing about 71% cumulative we have a retainage problem.
Good catch, cumulative disbursed including this draw would be 70.4% of the commitment. So slightly ahead of physical completion. I'll ask the borrower to trim line 7 or explain the stored materials.
Unrelated but heads up: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0189}} called asking about a draw on their renovation loan too. Told them we need the updated budget first. Same checklist applies, right?
Yes, same checklist. Inspection, lien waivers, title date-down, updated budget. Don't promise a timeline until the title update clears.
Understood, I'll send the document request this morning. Thanks Heidi.
For the {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0181}} file: the interest reserve balance should be checked too. Last I looked it was getting thin after draw #2.
Pulled it. Interest reserve has about $38K left, monthly carry is roughly $14K, so we're covered through November but not through projected completion. Flagging for the credit memo.
I'll raise it with the borrower. They may need to top up the reserve or we modify the budget. Tammy, any appetite for a reallocation from contingency?
Contingency is only 4% remaining and they've already used a chunk. I'd rather see a cash top-up. Reallocation would need Brian's sign-off anyway.
Does anyone know if the title company has the date-down for the {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0181}} property ordered? Checking before I chase them.
